findings.issue: The 'Request a quote for watersports apparel' button still sits right on the tinted trustBar band. It ends about 2px above the band on desktop and touches it on mobile, because the plain hero has no bottom padding of its own. This was raised in the last review and is still unfixed in the current shots.
findings.reference: The competitor leaves open white space under its title, lead and two black buttons before its next module ('Built for Swimwear') starts.
findings.fix: In template.css, give the plain hero's inner a bottom padding (.page-hero[data-variant="plain"] .page-hero__inner { padding-bottom: calc(var(--section-space) / 2) }), at least when the next block carries a background.

findings.issue: splitMedia-1, splitMedia-2 and splitMedia-2-steps still share one beige tint, so three tinted blocks run one under the other, and the gaps inside the run are uneven. On desktop the photo starts about 40px under splitMedia-1's last line, while the steps start about 100px under the photo. On mobile, splitMedia-2's first line starts right at the block's top edge. This was raised in the last review and is still unfixed.
findings.reference: The competitor alternates white sections with its single pink-tinted Sampling panel; no two tinted modules touch, and the gaps between modules are even.
findings.fix: The template's background alternation should count splitMedia-2 (with its steps, which carry their own heading) as the next plain section. Set it on white so the run reads tint / white, with the section spacing restored above the photo row and above the steps.

findings.issue: owner-testimonials and related, two neighbouring plain sections, both stand on white, so the white/tint alternation breaks after the photo band (testimonials white, related white, faq tint, cta white). The same holds on mobile.
findings.reference: Site rule: neighbouring plain sections alternate white and tinted backgrounds, set by the template. The competitor never sets two plain modules of the same ground where it uses a tint.
findings.fix: Let the template's alternation (through --section-tint) restart correctly after the gallery band, so related takes the tint and faq and cta follow white / tint. Paint no single section in reference.css.

findings.issue: The steps' intro, 'How a typical order runs from brief to shipment.', now stands in for the section heading at card-heading size (about 20px). On desktop it is still clearly smaller than the 01–07 numbers beside it (2rem) and the page's other H2s (about 32px), so it reads as a caption. On mobile it now reads at near heading size. This was raised in the last review and is only partly fixed.
findings.reference: The competitor's section headings ('MOQs', 'Sampling') are clearly larger than body text and their item titles, in a medium weight.
findings.fix: The template should promote a process list's heading-less intro to the section-heading level, fitted to its own words like the page's other H2s (weight 500), at every width. Then drop the site's own sizing of that lead (the --size-subheading override on .block--process and the font-size on line 345 of reference.css).

findings.issue: The beige lead-time chart panel still ends only about 40px above the beige splitMedia-1 band (about 35px on mobile). It nearly merges with the next section and reads as a notch of it, not as part of the white overview section.
findings.reference: The competitor's figures (the costing handover, the fabric card) sit on the white section, with the normal gap before the next module, and never in the colour of the band that follows.
findings.fix: In reference.css, give the overview's charts panel the section's own bottom spacing before the next block (e.g. margin-bottom: calc(var(--section-space) / 2) on .block--charts). Or, on a white section, set the panel on white with a hairline border instead of the next band's tint.

findings.issue: The seven related-page tiles still run 4 + 3, and the short last row of three starts on the left, leaving an empty slot under the fourth column. This was raised in the last review and is still unfixed.
findings.reference: Site rule: a grid's own short last row is centred. The competitor has no short rows hanging to the left.
findings.fix: In the template, centre the related grid's short last row (e.g. a flex-wrap row with justify-content: center and a shared tile basis), as for other card grids.

findings.issue: The intro paragraphs still run about 810px wide, roughly 95–100 characters a line, well past the ~70ch measure. The cta paragraph below is just as wide. This was raised in the last review and is still unfixed.
findings.reference: treatment-practice.md holds running text to about 70ch (the audit flags over 80ch); the competitor's intro copy runs a similar length but this site's measure rule applies.
findings.fix: In reference.css, give the text column of .block--intro and .block--cta a max-width of about 70ch, starting on the heading's left edge.

findings.issue: The open FAQ answer runs about 810px wide in the right-hand column, about 95–100 characters a line ('We offer UPF 50+ fabrics. On request, we also offer chlorine-resistant fabrics such as LYCRA Xtra Life.'), past the ~70ch measure.
findings.reference: treatment-practice.md holds running text to about 70ch at every width.
findings.fix: In reference.css, cap the answer text of .block--faq .faq__item at about 70ch (max-width on the answer's paragraphs), leaving the question rows their full width.
